Finite samples alone are not used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: For an infinite natural family of six-regular cycle powers, complete dihedral characters distinguish two reflection conjugacy classes and determine whether rational homology classes survive all automorphisms. The nonzero H2 and H3 for even n each transform differently, so the fully dihedral orbit space is rationally acyclic while the rotation-only quotient retains degree-one homology. The theorem is not a rephrasing of known nonequivariant Betti numbers and its exact local Smith certificate supplies reproducible structural information.
